sources.title: Sycophancy in Large Language Models: Causes and Mitigations
sources.snippet: We also discuss the broader implications of sycophancy for AI alignment and propose directions for future research. Our analysis suggests that mitigating sycophancy is crucial for developing more robust, reliable, and ethically-aligned language models.

sources.title: Sycophancy in Large Language Models: Causes and Mitigations
sources.snippet: This paper provides a technical survey of sycophancy in LLMs, synthesizing recent research on its causes, impacts, and potential mitigation strategies. We begin by examining methods for measuring and quantifying sycophantic tendencies, a crucial first step in addressing the problem.
